aboutMe.p1: I am a <c>Frontend Developer</c> with experience in <c>fullstack</c> environments, specialized in building <c>modern</c>, <c>accessible</c>, and <c>maintainable</c> interfaces, with a strong focus on <c>UI/UX</c>, <c>clean code</c>, and <c>best practices</c>.
aboutMe.p2: I have participated in the <c>technical direction of projects</c>, coordinating teams and taking responsibility for <c>code review and validation</c> before its <c>deployment</c>, ensuring quality and consistency.
aboutMe.p3: Although my main focus is Frontend, I work <c>end-to-end</c>, covering Frontend, Backend, and deployments. I am based in the <c>Basque Country</c>, with availability for <c>remote work</c> and collaboration in <c>international environments</c>.

oreka.title: Fullstack Developer | Technical Owner
oreka.description: Technical definition and execution of web products, including architectural decisions, technology selection, end-to-end development, and production deployment.

gestioma.title: Fullstack Developer
gestioma.description: Development of technical web platforms for engineering and 3D modeling, contributing to fullstack architecture, data management, and application deployment.

taskManager.p1: A task management application that allows users to create, organize, and delete tasks within customizable lists.
taskManager.p2: Includes a simple yet fully functional authentication system.

portfolio.p1: Portfolio of Alex Gutierrez (this website). A complete rework of the previous version, which was an outdated single-page application.
portfolio.p2: The goal was to create a cleaner, more elegant, minimalist design with improved responsiveness and enhanced accessibility (themes, translations, etc.).

videogameDatabase.title: Videogame Database
videogameDatabase.p1: An information platform covering all types of video games.
videogameDatabase.p2: It integrates the rawg.io API to retrieve comprehensive data, including Metacritic scores.

liftMonitor.title: LiftMonitor
liftMonitor.p1: Web application designed for tracking and recording strength training sessions, allowing users to store lifted weights in a structured way for each workout.
liftMonitor.p2: It includes a login and registration system, JWT-based authentication, and its own database.

layera.title: Layera
layera.p1: A perfume layering platform that allows users to build their fragrance collection and discover personalized layering combinations.
layera.p2: Features AI-powered recommendations for creating unique scent profiles tailored to different occasions, weather conditions, and personal preferences.

gameQueue.p1: Information platform showcasing video games releasing this month, featuring images, store links, and detailed info about selected titles.
gameQueue.p2: It uses the rawg.io API to fetch comprehensive game data and multimedia.
